title: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) — Mock 03
pattern: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 120 min · no −ve)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The EMF equation of a transformer is E = 4.44 f N Φm. What does Φm represent?
questions.solution: Φm is the maximum flux in the core per cycle.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The turns ratio of a transformer is defined as:
questions.solution: For an ideal transformer, N₁/N₂ = V₁/V₂ = I₂/I₁.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Voltage regulation of a transformer is given by:
questions.solution: VR = (E₂ − V₂) / V₂ × 100 at rated current and given PF.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In an open-circuit (OC) test on a transformer, which losses are measured?
questions.solution: OC test is conducted at rated voltage and rated frequency to measure core losses.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a short-circuit (SC) test on a transformer, which losses are measured?
questions.solution: SC test is conducted at rated current to measure copper losses.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The efficiency of a transformer is maximum when:
questions.solution: Maximum efficiency occurs when variable copper losses equal fixed iron losses.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An auto-transformer has a transformation ratio of 0.8. If the input is 400 V, the output is:

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A current transformer (CT) is used to:
questions.solution: CT steps down high currents to measurable levels (typically 1A or 5A secondary).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A potential transformer (PT) is used to:
questions.solution: PT steps down high voltages to safe measurable levels (typically 110V secondary).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Every mechanised outlet (shaft or incline) is examined at least once in every 7 days by:
options: An engineer, electrical supervisor or foreman, or a competent person authorised by the engineer
The district magistrate of the area
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 75(2): mechanised outlets are examined at least once in 7 days by an engineer, electrical supervisor or foreman (or authorised competent person), recorded in a bound paged book.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer oil is used for:
questions.solution: Transformer oil provides both dielectric insulation and heat transfer.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An on-load tap changer (OLTC) is used to:
questions.solution: OLTC adjusts the turns ratio while the transformer is carrying load to regulate voltage.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The no-load current of a transformer is typically what percentage of rated current?
questions.solution: No-load current is small (2–5%), needed to supply core losses and magnetizing flux.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The phase displacement between primary and secondary in a Dyn11 vector group is:
questions.solution: Dyn11: D (delta primary), y (star secondary), n (neutral), 11 means +30° lead.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Hysteresis loss in a transformer core depends on:
options: Frequency, Bmax, and volume of core
questions.solution: Ph = η × f × Bmax^n × V, where η is Steinmetz coefficient, n ≈ 1.6–2.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Eddy current loss in a transformer core is proportional to:
questions.solution: Pe = Ke × Bmax² × f² × t² × V (t = lamination thickness).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Lamination thickness in transformer cores is kept small to:
questions.solution: Thinner laminations increase resistance path for eddy currents, reducing losses.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The open-circuit test is usually performed on which side of a transformer?
questions.solution: OC test is done on LV side (low voltage, rated voltage easily available, low current).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The short-circuit test is usually performed on which side?
questions.solution: SC test is done on HV side (rated current at low voltage, easier to arrange on HV).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: If the supply frequency of a transformer is doubled while flux is halved, the EMF:
questions.solution: E ∝ f × Φm. If f doubles and Φm halves, product stays same.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The polarity test on a transformer is performed to:
questions.solution: Polarity test identifies additive or subtractive polarity for correct parallel operation.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Two transformers can operate in parallel only if they have:
options: Same manufacturer and year of make
Same polarity and same voltage ratio
questions.solution: Same polarity, voltage ratio, and compatible impedance for load sharing.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Percent impedance of a transformer is determined from:
questions.solution: %Z = (SC voltage / rated voltage) × 100, measured from SC test data.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a transformer, the leakage reactance is:
questions.solution: Leakage reactance is a design parameter that remains constant (approximately) regardless of load.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a cause of transformer failure?
questions.solution: Correct voltage regulation is normal operation, not a cause of failure.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Buchholz relay is used in transformers for:
questions.solution: Buchholz relay detects gas accumulation from internal faults (incipient faults).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The surge diverger on a transformer is used for:
questions.solution: Surge diverters (lightning arresters) protect against transient overvoltages.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An earth fault relay on a transformer is connected through:
options: Both CT on phases and CT on neutral
questions.solution: Earth fault relay operates using differential current from phase CTs and neutral CT.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The kVA rating of a transformer is limited by:
questions.solution: kVA is limited by the heating effect of current (copper loss and insulation temperature).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Skin effect in transformer windings increases with:
questions.solution: Skin effect increases with frequency due to current concentrating near conductor surface.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The tertiary winding in a three-phase transformer is used for:
questions.solution: Tertiary winding provides path for zero-sequence currents from unbalanced loads.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a Scott connection, two single-phase transformers are used to convert:
questions.solution: Scott connection converts 3-phase to 2-phase (or vice versa) for furnace supplies.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The transformer tap usually operates on which winding?
questions.solution: Tap changer is usually on HV winding because current is lower, reducing contact wear.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Oil temperature indicator in a transformer measures temperature at:
questions.solution: Oil temperature is measured at the top of the tank (hottest oil rises).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The conservator tank in a transformer is used for:
options: Providing space for oil expansion and contraction
questions.solution: Conservator accommodates oil expansion/contraction with temperature changes.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The breathers in a transformer are filled with:
questions.solution: Desiccants like silica gel absorb moisture from incoming air.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The impedance matching in a transformer is important for:
questions.solution: Transformers match impedance between source and load for maximum power transfer.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The copper loss in a transformer at half load is:
options: Half of full load copper loss
One-fourth of full load copper loss
questions.solution: Copper loss ∝ I², so at half load it is (½)² = ¼ of full load copper loss.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Which of the following affects voltage regulation of a transformer?
options: Both load power factor and winding impedance
questions.solution: VR depends on impedance drop (R and X) and load power factor.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Zero voltage regulation occurs at what power factor?
questions.solution: At a certain leading PF, the capacitive reactance drop cancels the resistance drop.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In an auto-transformer, the power transferred inductively is:
options: Less than the total power transferred
Equal to the total copper loss
questions.solution: Only a fraction (1−k) of power is transferred inductively; rest is conducted.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The magnetizing current in a transformer contains mainly:
questions.solution: Magnetizing current contains fundamental and 3rd, 5th, 7th harmonics (odd harmonics).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a transformer, the iron losses are also called:
questions.solution: Iron losses are constant because they depend on voltage and frequency, not load.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The maximum flux density in a transformer core is limited by:
questions.solution: Core saturates at high flux density, causing excessive magnetizing current and distortion.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The type of transformer used in a distribution system for stepping down to 415V is:
questions.solution: Distribution transformers operate at high efficiency at partial loads for 24/7 service.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The short-circuit impedance of a transformer limits:
questions.solution: Short-circuit impedance limits the maximum fault current during secondary short-circuit.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The tertiary winding in a three-winding transformer is usually connected in:
questions.solution: Tertiary delta winding provides path for 3rd harmonic currents and stabilizes neutral.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Oil filtering in a transformer is done to:
questions.solution: Filtering removes moisture, sludge, and impurities to restore dielectric strength.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The cooling tubes on a transformer tank are used for:
options: Providing a path for the cooling pump
Increasing oil surface area for natural cooling
questions.solution: Cooling tubes increase oil surface area exposed to air for better heat dissipation.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The efficiency of a distribution transformer at no load is approximately:
questions.solution: At no load, only core losses occur, so efficiency is very low.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The transformation ratio of a step-down transformer is:
questions.solution: For step-down, V₂ < V₁, so k = V₂/V₁ < 1.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: As per the Mines Act 1952, women may be employed aboveground only between:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.46: women shall not be employed belowground, and aboveground employment is restricted between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The EMF equation of a DC motor/generator is E = (ΦZN/60) × P/A. What is Z?
questions.solution: Z is the total number of armature conductors (active conductors on armature periphery).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Back EMF in a DC motor is given by:
questions.solution: Back EMF opposes the supply: Eb = V − IaRa (motor equation).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The torque equation of a DC motor is T = (ΦZIa × P) / (2πA). If flux is halved and armature current is doubled:
questions.solution: T ∝ Φ × Ia. Halving Φ and doubling Ia gives same torque.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a DC shunt motor, speed is approximately:
questions.solution: DC shunt motor has nearly constant speed due to the self-regulating nature.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A DC series motor has torque proportional to:
questions.solution: In series motor, Φ ∝ Ia (unsaturated), so T ∝ ΦIa ∝ Ia².

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A DC series motor should never be started on no-load because:
questions.solution: At no load, flux is very small, speed becomes dangerously high (runaway).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The maximum working hours in a week for an adult employed belowground in a mine are:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.28: no person shall be employed belowground for more than 48 hours in any week.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The no-volt release coil in a DC motor starter prevents:
options: Restarting after power failure while load is connected
questions.solution: No-volt release de-energizes if supply fails, preventing dangerous restart.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The overload release in a DC motor starter operates on:
questions.solution: Overload release trips the starter when armature current exceeds safe limit.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: When workings approach within 60 m of a water body or waterlogged area, the manager shall:
options: Stop working immediately without any plan
Leave the water body untouched forever
Install a signal lamp near the water body and continue working
Prepare a scheme for protection against inrush and drain the water in a planned manner
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 149 (danger from surface water) & Ch. XI: within 60 m, protective schemes (drainage, barriers) are implemented.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In return airways and old workings, the air shall normally contain oxygen not less than ______ and carbon dioxide not more than ______.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 165: not less than 19% oxygen and not more than 0.5% carbon dioxide.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Plugging (reverse current braking) of a DC motor involves:
questions.solution: Reversing armature supply terminals creates opposite torque, causing rapid deceleration.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In gassy mines, electric lighting from a source external to the lighting unit may be used on any roadway or place:
options: Ventilated by intake air or not within 270 m of the nearest face
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 176(1): external-source electric lighting is permitted on intake-air roadways or places not within 270 m of the nearest face.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: If the percentage of inflammable gas in the general body of air exceeds ______, persons shall be withdrawn from the working.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 166: persons are withdrawn when the general body of air exceeds 1.25% inflammable gas.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Interpoles in a DC machine are used to:
options: Neutralize armature reaction and improve commutation
questions.solution: Interpoles produce flux opposing armature reaction flux in the neutral zone.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Approaching a goaf, probing shall be carried out ahead of the working for at least:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 147: the working is probed ahead for at least 1.5 m beyond the last support before approaching the goaf.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Every engine, motor, transformer and battery-charging room on the surface of a mine shall be provided with at least:
options: Two exits, properly maintained and kept free from obstruction
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 212: such rooms are kept clean and provided with at least two exits, properly maintained and free from obstruction.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The critical speed of a DC generator is the speed below which:
questions.solution: Below critical speed, the magnetization curve is too low to build up voltage.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: While driving approaching old or waterlogged workings, advance boreholes shall be kept at least ______ ahead of the face.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 163: at least 3 advance boreholes not less than 3 m ahead of the face, with flank holes within 5 m on either side.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, notice of which of the following accidents is required to be given to the prescribed authorities?
options: Loss of life, serious bodily injury, explosion, ignition, fire, inrush of water or other matter
Loss of life and serious bodily injury only
Explosion and fire occurring in the opencast part only
Minor injuries and first-aid cases only
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.23: notice is required for loss of life, serious injury, and specified occurrences such as explosion, ignition, fire, inrush of water.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A DC motor's speed drops with load primarily because:
options: Back EMF decreases as Ia increases (IR drop)
questions.solution: As load increases, Ia increases, Eb = V − IaRa decreases, causing speed to drop.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, an Inspector may, among other powers:
options: Enter, inspect and examine a mine, and make inquiries on any matter relating to safety
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.22: Inspectors may enter, inspect, examine and inquire into any mine and its records.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The starting torque of a DC series motor is:
questions.solution: T ∝ Ia², so at high starting current, torque is very high.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a DC motor, the air gap flux density affects:
questions.solution: Flux affects both speed (N ∝ Eb/Φ) and torque (T ∝ ΦIa).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The direction of rotation of a DC motor can be reversed by:
options: Reversing either armature or field current
questions.solution: Reversing either reverses torque. Reversing both leaves torque unchanged.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The field weakening method of speed control is suitable for:
questions.solution: Field weakening reduces flux, increasing speed above base speed (constant power region).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The armature resistance control method is:
questions.solution: Energy is wasted in external resistance, making it inefficient at low speeds.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A DC shunt motor running at no load suddenly loses its field connection. What happens?
questions.solution: Loss of field means very low flux, speed tries to go to infinity (runaway).

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: At what time between 4 and 5 o'clock will the hands coincide?
questions.solution: θ = (60×4 - 5.5×0) / 5.5 = 240/5.5 = 43.64 min past 4. Approximately 4:21:49, closest to 4:22

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: What was the day of the week on 15th August 1947?
questions.solution: Using odd day method: 1947 Aug 15 → odd days = 1. Hence Friday

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The average of 5 numbers is 20. If one number is excluded, the average becomes 18. What is the excluded number?
questions.solution: Sum of 5 = 100. Sum of 4 = 72. Excluded = 100 - 72 = 28

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 3:30?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The Indian Constitution came into effect on:
questions.solution: Republic Day: 26 January 1950

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar is known as:
questions.solution: Dr. Ambedkar: Chairman of Drafting Committee

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which is the longest river in India?
questions.solution: Ganga: longest river in India (2525 km)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which is the highest peak in India?
questions.solution: Kangchenjunga: 8586m (highest in India)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: India won Cricket World Cup in:
questions.solution: India won: 1983 and 2011

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which state has the longest coastline in India?
questions.solution: Gujarat: longest coastline (~1600 km)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: RBI was established in:
questions.solution: RBI: 1935 (central bank of India)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Lok Sabha elections are held every:
questions.solution: General elections: every 5 years

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Rajya Sabha members are elected for:
questions.solution: Rajya Sabha: 6-year term, 1/3 retire every 2 years

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Indian Army Day is celebrated on:
questions.solution: Army Day: 15 January

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: NITI Aayog CEO is appointed by:
questions.solution: NITI Aayog: CEO appointed by PM

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which organization regulates space activities in India?
questions.solution: ISRO: Indian Space Research Organisation

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Pokhran-II nuclear tests were conducted in:
questions.solution: Pokhran-II: May 1998

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: India's first satellite Aryabhata was launched with help of:
questions.solution: Aryabhata: launched by Soviet Kosmos-3M (1975)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Green Revolution in India was led by:
questions.solution: M.S. Swaminathan: Father of Green Revolution in India

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: White Revolution (milk) in India was led by:
questions.solution: Verghese Kurien: Father of White Revolution (Operation Flood)
